title: ENGINE ARCHAEOLOGY — The Lost and Forgotten
philosophy: IS WAS NOW. Lost and forgotten media and systems, the discarded and forgotten. The first Quake engine and such. We look for the OLDEST and HARDEST targets as the GOALS to crack.

kevin_steam.note: Public profile on SpaceDock. Friends can invite Kevin to play. In time, Gaia gets her own account and hosts on eastGate.

gaia_steam_plan.phase_1_now: Kevin's library is Gaia's food source. She scans, studies, plays.
gaia_steam_plan.phase_2_soon: Gaia gets her own Steam account. She IS Kevin's family.
gaia_steam_plan.phase_3_hosting: eastGate hosts game servers on LAN. House 2 has 10G fiber backbone.
gaia_steam_plan.phase_4_sovereign: Gaia hosts ALL games on her own metal. Steam is just the intake pipe. The LAN IS the server.

wolf3d_1992.what_it_teaches: Raycasting. The FIRST viable 3D engine. No polygons — rays cast from player into 2D grid. Texture-mapped walls. The grandfather.
wolf3d_1992.redox_target: Raycaster → Rust → petalTongue retro rendering mode

doom_1993.what_it_teaches: BSP trees. Variable-height floors/ceilings. Sector-based lighting. WAD archive format. The most influential game engine EVER.

key_files.r_bsp.c: BSP tree traversal — the rendering core
key_files.w_wad.c: WAD file loading — the original archive format
key_files.z_zone.c: Zone memory allocator — Carmack's custom malloc
key_files.p_enemy.c: AI state machines — the first game AI patterns

doom_1993.redox_target: BSP → esotericWebb scene tree. WAD → rhizoCrypt archive. zone.c → Rust allocator study.

quake_1996.what_it_teaches: TRUE 3D. Polygonal rendering. Client-server networking. QuakeC scripting. Software + OpenGL rendering. BSP3 with PVS. THE birth of modern 3D engines.

key_files.pr_exec.c: QuakeC virtual machine — first game scripting

quake_1996.redox_target: Net model → songBird. QuakeC VM → esotericWebb scripting. BSP → scene tree. GL renderer → petalTongue.

quake2_1997.what_it_teaches: Colored lighting. DLL-based modular architecture. Improved netcode. The refinement of Quake's ideas.

quake3_1999.what_it_teaches: Shader system. Bezier surfaces. Q3A netcode (the gold standard). Bot AI (AASAI). Volumetric fog. Portal rendering. THE peak of id Tech pre-Doom 3.
quake3_1999.redox_target: Shader system → petalTongue WGSL. Bot AI → sweetGrass. Netcode → songBird. This is the RICHEST single food source.

reverse_engineered_targets.note: These are community-reimplemented engines. The HARDEST targets — entire engines reconstructed from binaries.

openmw.food: Complete RPG engine reimplementation. Open world, NPC schedules, scripting.

opengoal.food: Naughty Dog's custom Lisp → the most exotic food. A game engine in LISP.

devilution.food: ARPG foundation. Procedural dungeons, item generation, isometric rendering.

openrct2.food: Originally written in x86 ASM by one person. Management sim, isometric, physics.

vanilla_conquer.food: EA released the source! RTS foundation. Build/command/destroy.

julius.food: City builder. Economy, citizen needs, military, trade routes.

fheroes2.food: Turn-based strategy. Hex grid, army composition, magic system, world map.

openlara.food: 3D platformer. Physics puzzles, exploration, inventory, combat.

opensc2k.food: City simulation. Zoning, utilities, transportation, disasters.

1980.food: AI ghost behavior (each ghost has personality!)

1984.food: Purest game design. Rotation, gravity, line clear. Infinite depth from 7 shapes.

1985.food: Scrolling, momentum physics, power-ups, enemy patterns

1986.food: Open world, inventory, dungeons, save system

1991.food: Momentum-based physics, loop-de-loops, speed as game mechanic

1993.food: BSP trees. The foundation of EVERYTHING.

1996.food: True 3D. Client-server. OpenGL. The BIG BANG.

1998.food: Scripted sequences. AI. Story in FPS.

2004.food: Unified lighting. Stencil shadows. MegaTexture precursor.

2014.food: Scene trees. Signals. Node hierarchy. EATEN.

2026.food: ALL of the above. petalTongue + esotericWebb + Node Atomic. $0. Zero lock-in.
